location_qualifier: front south of Caen; day of entering the line
current_activity: 272nd Infantry Division enters the line in the Normandy front south of Caen after a rail move from the Pyrenees and a march from Angers
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 272. Infanterie-Division page: moved north by rail from Port-Vendres and La Nouvelle from 29 June 1944 (assembly area planned between Falaise and Caen); unloaded north and east of Angers, then marched; "Ab dem 11. Juli 1944 wurde die Division an der Front in der Normandie eingesetzt"; the table gives I. SS (Panzer Corps), Panzer Group West, for July. Location: the front south of Caen; the point is Bretteville-sur-Laize, with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the page says "an der Front in der Normandie" on 11 July and "südlich von Caen" by 16 July; the point is the town of the sector. Location support: moderate: one source family. Relationship: under the I SS Panzer Corps in July (Lexikon table); the start is the first day in the line and the end is open: the same page puts the division in the 28 July table row under the LXXXVI Corps.

location_qualifier: front south of Caen taken over from the 1st SS Panzer Division
source_locator: R599: Einsatz und Unterstellung (to 16 July 1944); R594: footnote 3 of the German list
current_activity: 272nd Infantry Division has relieved the 1st SS Panzer Division in the front south of Caen
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 272. Infanterie-Division page: "Bis zum 16. Juli löste die Division die 1. SS-Panzer-Division aus der Front südlich von Caen ab"; Nafziger Collection 944BGAA: a footnote to the 1st SS Panzer Division, "Being relieved by the 272nd Infantry Division"; the date is "by 16 July". Location: the front south of Caen, the point Bretteville-sur-Laize with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the sector of the 1st SS Panzer Division before 16 July, see C0773 and C0774. Location support: moderate: one source family (the Nafziger file is an order-of-battle compilation of the Tessin lineage). Relationship: the division is in the I SS Panzer Corps relation of the 11 July row.
